acceptance: `async fn` is a call protocol in every declaration position: top-level item, local statement, anonymous `async fn(...)` value and `impl` method, where the receiver travels as argument 0 of the spawned body
`await do ... end` desugars to sequential awaits; explicit `await` is accepted only as a statement, an initializer or a return value, and rejected elsewhere with AIPO_SEM_AWAIT_IN_SUBEXPRESSION
A known-`Task` value discarded without `await`, binding or combinator reports AIPO_SEM_FORGOTTEN_TASK, while a bound or returned task stays silent
A nested `await do` block reports AIPO_SEM_NESTED_AWAIT_DO
Awaiting a task that awaits itself faults with AIPO_RT_AWAIT_CYCLE and awaiting a cancelled task faults with AIPO_RT_CANCELLED, with identical behavior on the VM and the JS backend

Numeric literals are classified by a single shared module (aipo-lexer::number) used by both the lexer and the IR builder: malformed forms report AIPO_LEX_INVALID_NUMBER and literals outside the representable range fault with AIPO_RT_OVERFLOW
The conformance corpus grows by programs 24-27 and diagnostics 20-28, and every fixture is exercised by the CLI conformance suite and the VM/JS differential suite
cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace --all-targets and cargo doc --workspace --no-deps are all green
